instruction: Place the blue stapler with smooth finish on the Gray colored mat.

source.instruction: Place the blue stapler with smooth finish on the Gray colored mat.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the stapler, which was at x = +24 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above the stapler to (24, -18, 94) and orient vertically.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-7, +1, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -18, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm partially towards the stapler to z = 88.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -18, 88) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z = 78 and grasp the stapler.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler; closed the gripper (opening 0.24: holding the stapler)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -18, 78) opening 0.24; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift right arm up to z = 88.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (24, -18, 87) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm forward to (20, -2, 88) above the gray mat.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-4, +15, +1) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -2, 88) opening 0.26; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust yaw orientation by -90 degrees and slightly lower.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -2, 88) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the stapler onto the gray mat to z = 78.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -2, 78) opening 0.26; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open the right gripper to release the stapler.
